Base técnica robusta: Conhecimentos avançados em bancos de dados (Oracle, SQL Server, DB2), sistemas operacionais (SUSE) e domínio de administração de sistemas SAP. Ferramentas, idiomas e mindset: Experiência com ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Grafana e Dynatrace, além de forte compromisso com aprendizado contínuo e evolução tecnológica.

title: Visual & Brand Experience Designer
description: Visual & Brand Experience DesignerAbout the Role We are seeking an experienced Visual & Brand Experience Designer to support a large-scale digital product initiative focused on modernizing the user experience of a leading marketplace platform. This role will play a key part in reimagining how customers navigate and interact with a multi-brand digital ecosystem.You will lead the Visual Makeover & Usability workstream while also helping shape a multi-brand gallery experience that brings together multiple brands within a single marketplace environment. The ideal candidate is a highly creative product designer who can quickly move from research and benchmarking into compelling visual concepts that inspire stakeholders and guide product direction.This is a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles, so comfort working in ambiguous environments and presenting bold ideas to senior stakeholders is essential.What You'll Do Design and lead the visual direction for key product workstreams focused on improving usability and modernizing the marketplace interface. Conduct benchmarking of leading global marketplace platforms to inform design strategy and identify best-in-class user experience patterns. Develop high-fidelity visual concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate new interface directions and inspire product leadership. Design and prototype a multi-brand navigation and discovery experience that enables users to seamlessly browse across brands within a unified marketplace. Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to translate design ideas into clear product directions. Present design concepts and rationale to senior stakeholders, helping guide decision-making around product experience and visual identity. Work within a fast-moving consulting team delivering iterative design outputs across short delivery cycles.Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience in product design, visual design, or UI design Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality interface design and visual storytelling Deep understanding of e-commerce and marketplace design patterns Experience analyzing and benchmarking international digital products Ability to produce high-fidelity concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate bold design ideas Comfort presenting conceptual work to senior leadership and stakeholders Fluency in Portuguese (required working language) Ability to thrive in fast-paced consulting environments with rapid iteration cyclesPreferred Qualifications Experience designing multi-brand digital ecosystems or marketplaces Familiarity with Asian marketplace and super-app UX paradigms such as those seen in Alibaba, Shopee, or Pinduoduo Background working with retail, consumer products, or marketplace platforms Previous experience in agency or consulting environments with fast delivery timelinesIf you're a designer who enjoys pushing visual boundaries, exploring global product patterns, and shaping the experience of large-scale digital platforms, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a high-visibility product initiative.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations. Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions. Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
Development of policiesgoverning margin lending and virtual asset collateral Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements Net-worth monitoring;
Review and monitor riskindicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board. Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations. Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters. Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies. Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.Requirements: Legally resident in Brazil. Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years)in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms. Demonstratedindependence from commercial functionsand ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function. Strong knowledge ofCentral Bank of Brazilrisk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements. Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets. Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field;
postgraduate qualification preferred. Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills;
fluency inPortuguese and English. Must meetfit and properstandards withno disqualifying factors, including: not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised. not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Customer Success Specialist, Life Sciences

title: English Teacher
description: Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que unetecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitaispara solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora comoparte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.Empresas comoSmiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgásconfiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantirambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura demulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados.Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiarvalidações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas.Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimento prático dePython para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial comDatabricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado.Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio).Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente!

description:
Seu talento impulsiona o nosso futuroAGetneté uma empresa global de tecnologia especializada em soluções de pagamento para o comércio. Oferecemos uma plataforma unificada que integra hardware, software, prevenção à fraude, adquirência, conciliação e serviços financeiros — tudo em um só ecossistema, para que nossos clientes possam focar no crescimento do seu negócio. Fazer parte da Getnet é se juntar a uma empresa que combina a inovação de uma fintech com a solidez de um banco global. Imagine your future. Care for your career. Simplify your journey. Isso significa que você terá a chance de construir soluções de impacto, crescer com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e evoluir em uma cultura que valoriza bem-estar, inclusão e clareza. Combinamos flexibilidade, autonomia e colaboração global — para que você possa focar no que importa, se conectar com propósito e ajudar a moldar o futuro. Aqui, você vai encontrar espaço para crescer, oportunidades reais para liderar e uma cultura onde todas as pessoas pertencem e contribuem. Se você quer fazer parte da próxima geração de soluções financeiras, este é o lugar certo. Já te imagina sendo Nxter?Na Getnet, estamos buscando uma pessoa para a vaga de Staff AI Engineer | AI Orchestration & SDLC Automation para se juntar ao nosso time no Brasil (Porto Alegre/RS ou São Paulo/RS)O que você vai fazer Estamos buscando uma pessoa que irá atuar como Staff-level Engineer para projetar e gerenciar uma camada de orquestração de IA incorporada em nossos pipelines de CI/CD, transformando a IA em uma capacidade de engenharia de software controlada e escalável. Essa função é responsável por institucionalizar agentes de IA (começando com Devin), automatizando o ciclo de vida do software de ponta a ponta, preservando a propriedade e a responsabilidade humanas.AI Orchestration & Architecture: Projetar e implementar uma camada de orquestração de IA integrada ao pipeline de CI/CD. Orquestrar agentes e habilidades de IA em todas as etapas do SDLC (design, desenvolvimento, teste, refatoração). Definir como as sessões de IA são criadas, gerenciadas, versionadas, auditadas e revisadas.Context Engineering at Scale: Projetar mecanismos para provisionar automaticamente o contexto por projeto, incluindo: Bases de código Arquitetura e documentação Padrões e políticas Histórico de tickets e incidentes Garantir que a IA opere com um contexto preciso, delimitado e em conformidade desde o primeiro dia.SDLC Automation & Ticket Flow Automatize fluxos de trabalho a partir de tickets do Jira: Ingestão e classificação de tickets Criação automática de sessões de IA Vinculação de contexto e definição do escopo da tarefa Ciclos de revisão e aprovação humana Habilite a rastreabilidade de ticket → código → testes → implantação.CI/CD Integration Incorpore a orquestração de IA em pipelines de CI/CD para: Geração e modificação de código Geração e manutenção automatizadas de testes Revisões de PR e verificações de qualidade Verificações de conformidade e segurança Garanta que os resultados da IA sejam governados, repetíveis e mensuráveis.Devin Deployment & Scaling
- Liderar a implementação inicial do Devin em toda a organização.
- Definir padrões de uso, diretrizes e modelos de adoção.
- Garantir que o Devin evolua de uma ferramenta para uma capacidade de engenharia padronizada.Measurement & Governance Definir métricas para medir o impacto da IA na produtividade, qualidade e confiabilidade. Garantir que toda a atividade de IA seja observável, auditável e alinhada com a governança corporativa. Aprimorar continuamente a orquestração com base em resultados e feedback.Technical Leadership Atuar como responsável técnico pela IA dentro do SDLC (Ciclo de Vida de Desenvolvimento de Software). Colaborar com as equipes de Plataforma, DevOps, QA (Garantia da Qualidade), Segurança e Arquitetura. Orientar engenheiros seniores e definir as melhores práticas. O que buscamos em você
- Sólida experiência profissional em engenharia de software.

title: Chief Engineer (Process Safety)
description: Our Client, a leading oil and gas engineering firm in Singapore, is seeking a highly experienced Chief Engineer (Process Safety) with 22+ years of expertise to join their team. AgileHRO will handle the Singapore Employment Pass sponsorship and relocation for the successful Brazilian candidate.Important: This role is based in Singapore and requires relocationRole Description Independently develop/oversee design safety philosophy, HSE Plan, and specifications for fire protection systems (active and passive), HFE, etc. Lead/participate in process hazard reviews and analysis, including HAZOP/HAZID/SIL studies, and be responsible for action close-outs. Lead/chair the HAZOP/HAZID/SIL workshops, if required. Review third-party safety studies, including FERA, dispersion analysis, EERA, ESSA, dropped objects study, QRA studies, etc. (not limited to). Capable of independently carrying out similar safety studies, as required. Independently design active and passive fire protection systems and prepare Hazardous/H2S Area Classification documentation, safety and firefighting layouts, escape route and lifesaving equipment layout, and other safety drawings. Carry out safety critical elements performance standards, RAM, fire and gas detection mapping, etc., based on project requirements. Act as Package Engineer, if required, for safety and firefighting equipment. Manage and guide Junior/Senior Engineers and Designers on Concept/FEED/Detailed Engineering projects. Provide health and environmental inputs (including health risk assessments such as chemical exposure, noise and lighting, ergonomics/human factors engineering, environmental impact assessments, etc.) to projects. Interface/coordinate with other engineering disciplines and clients, and take the lead in resolving technical matters related to safety aspects. Deliver project safety deliverables as per the project schedule. Provide inputs and support to projects in all safety aspects, including progress reports. Provide advisory support and oversight to the Process Safety Team for their activities and deliverables and ensure technical integrity and quality. Provide support for new bid proposals, including deliverable lists/manhour estimates, etc.Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering or equivalent from an accredited university. Minimum 22 years of relevant design engineering experience, including as a Technical Advisor. Good HSE engineering experience in the oil and gas industry, in process safety/technical safety, with a minimum of 5-7 years in a lead position on similar projects. Involvement in pre- Feed, Feed, Detail design projects for offshore (FPSO/platforms) and onshore (refineries, LNG facilities, storage terminals, etc.). Experience in a minimum number of offshore projects (FPSO/platforms). Good knowledge of oil and gas process facilities, local and international process safety codes and standards, and regulatory/marine codes and standards (MODU, SOLAS, DNV/Lloyds Register). Hands-on experience in plot plan review, HAZID, HAZOP, SIL classification/verification, and other safety reviews (e.G., SIMOPS, ALARP). Good working knowledge of PIPENET Vision, Flaresim, and other consequence modeling software such as DNV PHAST, etc. Ability to influence designs to achieve optimal HSE outcomes. A team player with leadership potential and proactive inter-discipline communication skills.

title: Key Account - O&G
description:
Key Account - O&GBuscamos profissionais que incorporem nossos valores, não têm medo de desafios, busquem inovar, experimentar e se aprimorar rapidamente. Nosso objetivo é contratar e reter os indivíduos mais brilhantes, oferecendo crescimento profissional e oportunidades de desenvolvimento em toda a carreira. Se é você, adoraríamos conversar.Sobre o papel Estamos em busca de umKey Account na área de Óleo e Gáspara liderar a relação estratégica e impulsionar o crescimento no segmento de Óleo & Gás, atuando como principal ponto focal da conta. Essa posição será responsável por influenciar demandas e editais, identificar oportunidades ao longo da cadeia técnica e conduzir vendas consultivas complexas de serviços TIC e/ou equipamentos de alto valor agregado. Espera-se um perfil com forte bagagem técnica, capacidade de relacionamento em alto nível, poder de influência e visão estratégica, além de protagonismo na expansão de negócios tanto na Petrobras quanto em novos clientes do setor.Sobre o Grupo Bureau Veritas Fundado em 1828, somos líder mundial em serviços de testes laboratoriais, inspeção e certificação, possuímos mais de 74 mil funcionários em 1.400 escritórios e laboratórios ao redor do globo. Nossa missão é oferecer serviços e soluções inovadoras para garantir que os ativos, produtos e processos de nossos mais de 400 mil clientes atendam a padrões e regulamentos em termos de qualidade, saúde, segurança, proteção ambiental e responsabilidade social. Há 190 anos nossa marca é sinônimo de integridade e confiança, em benefício dos negócios e das pessoas, contribuindo para transformar o mundo em que vivemos. Para saber um pouco mais acesse o site responsabilidades:Desenvolver e sustentar conexões de alto nível com stakeholders estratégicos (áreas técnicas, suprimentos e liderança), fortalecendo o posicionamento institucional Influenciar tecnicamente e comercialmente a construção de editais e demandas, a partir do entendimento das necessidades do cliente. Mapear oportunidades dentro da cadeia de valor de O&G, com foco em serviços TIC (Teste, Inspeção e Certificação) e soluções técnicas associadas Conduzir vendas consultivas complexas, envolvendo serviços e/ou equipamentos de alto valor agregado para aplicações em infraestrutura, embarcações e plataformas;
Atuar de forma estratégica na identificação de demandas técnicas críticas (ex.: integridade de ativos, corrosão, manutenção industrial), propondo soluções customizadas;
Gerenciar e expandir contas-chave (KAM), garantindo crescimento sustentável e aumento de participação dentro do cliente;
Desenvolver novas contas no segmento de Óleo & Gás, ampliando a presença da empresa no mercado e gerando novas frentes de receita Coordenar internamente com equipes técnicas e operacionais para construção de propostas robustas e aderentes às exigências do cliente Atuar com forte protagonismo na negociação de contratos complexos e de grande porte Acompanhar tendências regulatórias, técnicas e comerciais do setor, incluindo conhecimento aplicado em SEMPS Garantir o atingimento das metas comerciais, acompanhando indicadores de performance e pipeline de vendasO que buscamos: Experiência em posições comerciais no setor de TIC (Teste, Inspeção e Certificação), com forte atuação no segmento de Óleo & Gás;
Experiência comprovada na gestão de contas estratégicas (KAM), com foco em O&A Conhecimento aprofundado da cadeia técnica e de suprimentos, incluindo dinâmica de editais e processos comerciais Vivência com venda de serviços técnicos e equipamentos para aplicações industriais, offshore, embarcações e plataformas Background técnico, preferencialmente com formação em engenharia ou áreas correlatas Familiaridade com normas, processos e sistemas aplicáveis ao setor (ex.: SEMPS) Forte habilidade de influência, negociação e relacionamento em ambientes complexos Perfil proativo e com visão estratégica;
Capacidade de transitarentre áreas técnicas e executivas, com comunicação eficaz em múltiplos níveis;
O que nós podemos oferecer: Esta é uma ótima oportunidade para desenvolver sua carreira, trabalhando em uma equipe de especialistas. Nossos colaboradores são inovadores, curiosos e ambiciosos, sempre motivados e focados em novas soluções, pois, somos constantemente desafiados por uma indústria em rápida evolução que inclui um portfólio global de clientes, com milhares empresas, grandes e pequenas que confiam em nosso trabalho para melhorar seus negócios. Ao participar deste processo de recrutamento & seleção, do Bureau Veritas Brasil, o(a) candidato(a) declara: Estar em condições técnicas e operacionais, no que tange à ergonomia, estação de trabalho e velocidade de conexão internet para desempenhar, quando necessário, o trabalho remoto "home office";
O Bureau Veritas está em conformidade com a Constituição Federal brasileira (no inc. V do seu art. 5o.Inc. XXVIII, a, do art. 5o) bem como, a Lei no 13.709/18, que dispõe sobre o Tratamento e Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD). Sendo assim, mediante o seu consentimento com o envio de informações está em consonância com o Bureau Veritas, respeitando a Legislação supramencionada.

title: Oficial Operacional Geral
description:
Oficial Operacional Geral (Manutenção & Multitarefas)Procuramos um Oficial Operacional Geral (Manutenção & Multitarefas) para integrar nossa equipe de administração de imóveis por temporada no Rio de Janeiro/RJ. Se você é proativo, tem múltiplas habilidades em manutenção e busca uma oportunidade dinâmica, essa vaga é para você!Sobre a VagaSua missão será garantir que nossos imóveis estejam sempre em perfeitas condições para os hóspedes. A rotina envolverá manutenções preventivas e corretivas em diversos apartamentos, além de atendimentos emergenciais que exigem agilidade e foco na solução.O que você vai fazer:Realizar manutenção geral e reparos, incluindo mas não se limitando:
- Trocar lâmpadas, chuveiros, torneiras, sifões de pia, tomadas e interruptores simples, e outras atividades relacionadas.
- Ajustar portas de armário, dobradiças, puxadores e maçanetas, e outras atividades relacionadas.
- Aplicar silicone e vedação simples em pias, cubas e box, e outras atividades relacionadas.
- Instalar suportes, prateleiras, varões e quadros com furadeira e parafusadeira, e outras atividades relacionadas.
- Tampar pequenos furos com massa corrida (correções estéticas pontuais), e outras atividades relacionadas.
- Testar e reiniciar equipamentos como roteador, TV, ar-condicionado e eletrodomésticos pequenos, e outras atividades relacionadas.
- Desentupir pias, ralos e vasos sanitários com desentupidor manual ou produto químico de uso doméstico, e outras atividades relacionadas.
- Realizar montagem e instalações simples.
- Montar móveis de pequeno porte seguindo manual (ex: cama box, mesa, cadeira, cômoda, criado-mudo, estantes), e outras atividades relacionadas.
- Utilizar ferramentas manuais e elétricas leves de forma segura, e outras atividades relacionadas.
- Realizar acompanhamento de serviços de terceiros.
- Estar presente nos apartamentos durante montagens, instalações ou manutenções feitas por empresas contratadas, e outras atividades relacionadas.
- Abrir e fechar o imóvel, liberar o acesso e acompanhar a execução dos serviços, e outras atividades relacionadas.
- Reportar à equipe qualquer problema, atraso ou necessidade observada durante o acompanhamento, e outras atividades relacionadas.
- Realizar vistorias preventivas (sob escala definida).
- Verificar funcionamento de iluminação, tomadas e interruptores, e outras atividades relacionadas.
- Checar funcionamento de ar-condicionado, TVs, Wi-Fi e eletrodomésticos, e outras atividades relacionadas.
- Conferir descargas, torneiras, vazamentos e funcionamento hidráulico geral, e outras atividades relacionadas.
- Avaliar portas, trincos, fechaduras mecânicas e digitais, e outras atividades relacionadas.
- Identificar sinais de desgaste, manutenção pendente ou problemas em geral e informar à equipe, e outras atividades relacionadas.
- Manter comunicação constante com a equipe.
- Utilizar aplicativos para celular para enviar fotos, registros e atualizações sobre cada atendimento ou vistoria, e outras atividades relacionadas.
- Reportar com clareza problemas detectados durante as atividades, e outras atividades relacionadas.
- Manter postura profissional e comunicação objetiva, e outras atividades relacionadas.As atividades que listamos aqui são as principais, mas o trabalho pode ter outras coisas parecidas que apareçam no dia a dia.O que Buscamos em Você
- Experiência comprovada em manutenção geral, com habilidades diversas (elétrica, hidráulica, pintura, pequenos reparos).
- Capacidade de organização e planejamento para gerenciar múltiplas tarefas e prioridades.
- Proatividade na identificação de problemas e busca de soluções antes que se tornem urgências.
- Olhar atento aos detalhes para identificar pequenas falhas e realizar acabamentos impecáveis.
- Bom raciocínio lógico para diagnosticar problemas complexos e encontrar as melhores soluções.
- Habilidade para trabalhar sob pressão em situações emergenciais, mantendo a calma e a eficiência.
- Excelente gestão do tempo para cumprir prazos e otimizar o roteiro de atendimentos.
- Foco em soluções e capacidade de encontrar alternativas criativas para desafios inesperados.
- Familiaridade com o uso seguro e a manutenção básica de ferramentas (manuais e elétricas).
- Postura ética e discrição ao lidar com a privacidade dos hóspedes e dos imóveis.
- Agilidade e prontidão para atender a chamados de emergência.
- Excelente comunicação e proatividade.
- Disponibilidade para trabalhar na cidade do Rio de Janeiro e se deslocar rapidamente entre os imóveis.
- Possuir veículo próprio (preferencialmente moto) e CNH válida é um diferencial, com auxílio específico para o uso.
- Experiência prévia em manutenção de imóveis para temporada, hotelaria, predial e/ou residencial será um grande diferencial.Formato de Contratação e Remuneração

title: Arquiteto De Soluções Sap
description:

Juntas, asseguram tanto a implementação quanto a sustentação e otimização de sistemas críticos, garantindo que os clientes tenham segurança, performance e evolução constante. O arquiteto será o elo entre as áreas técnicas (consultores e GPs), áreas de negócio e o GDE (Gestor de Desenvolvimento Estratégico), garantindo sinergia, clareza e valor nas soluções apresentadas — desde o desenho até a entrega final.Responsabilidades Principais:Entendimento de demanda : Analisar documentos enviados por clientes ou realizar alinhamentos diretos para mapear necessidades técnicas e de negócio;

Documentação estratégica : Produzir documentos técnicos completos, mapas de batalha, cronogramas (macro e micro), e artefatos de apoio ao time de delivery, sempre alinhados ao Gerente de Projetos (GP);
Integração interfuncional:Estabelecer sinergia entre os times de delivery, consultores, GP e GDE, assegurando o entendimento integral da solução e seus impactos;
Elaboração da proposta final:Consolidar e apresentar a proposta técnica e comercial final, validada com o GP e o GDE;
Respostas a RFPs: Ser responsável direto pela elaboração de respostas técnicas e comerciais a RFPs (Requests for Proposal), garantindo assertividade, alinhamento com os objetivos do cliente e diferenciação competitiva.Requisitos:Experiência comprovada com múltiplas soluções SAP;
Experiência comprovada em modelar arquiteturas para soluções SAP (RISE, GROW, BTP, CX, S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, entre outras);
Domínio em elaboração de propostas técnicas e comerciais;
Familiaridade com frameworks como SAP Activate, Clean Core, Signavio, SAP BTP e LeanIX;
Capacidade de comunicação clara com perfis técnicos e executivos;
Experiência com resposta a RFPs e participação em ciclos de pré-venda;
Perfil consultivo, colaborativo e orientado a valor de negócio.Diferenciais:Experiência com clientes enterprise e propostas de alto valor;
Atuação em ambientes híbridos com múltiplas plataformas (ex: SAP + Salesforce + ServiceNow);
Procuramos um profissional organizado, proativo e engajado, com espírito de equipe e curiosidade para obter conhecimento do negócio. Este consultor deve trabalhar com paixão, foco e propósito, sempre buscando a excelência em suas atividades. Valorizamos a humildade e a ambição de fazer sempre mais e melhor, transformando erros e dificuldades em oportunidades de crescimento e inovação. Se você se encaixa nesse perfil, queremos conhecer você!#VemSerLPJ #Compartilhe

title: Billing Analyst
description:
About the Role We are hiring a Billing Analyst (Contracts & Invoicing) to support a high-volume, enterprise B2B billing operation within the telecommunications industry. This role owns the contractual and invoicing control stages of the Order-to-Cash process, acting as a quality, compliance, and accuracy gate between approved Purchase Orders and customer invoices. The position requires strong ERP execution, billing governance, and cross-functional organization.Key Responsibilities Execute and control the Contracts & Invoicing stages of the Order-to-Cash process. Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures. Create, update, and validate Sales Orders in ERP systems. Prepare and review invoice drafts, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness. Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability. Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories. Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels. Coordinate with Sales, Contracts, Projects, PMO, Warehouse, and Finance to obtain required billing inputs. Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up.Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations. Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes. Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable). Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting). Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance. Professional proficiency in English.Preferred Qualifications Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services. Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers. Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs. Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments.Our compensation package: - Contract as Brazilian Labor Laws (CLT).
- Profit Sharing.
- Transportation vouchers.
- Meals vouchers.
- Health and Dental insurance.
- Birthday day off.
- Gympass / Totalpass.If you see yourself in this position and would like to become a part of ZTE group, please apply sending you resume in English version. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo's projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo's data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter towith subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Executivo Comercial Hunter - Grandes Contas - Mercado Pago | Natal, Rn.
description: No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias. Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico, para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina. Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques. Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.Temos um desafio para as pessoas que: Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites. Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação. Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros. A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas. Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão. Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores,e sendo responsável por:Prospectar ativamente novos clientes com o perfil de Grandes Contas. Atuar de forma consultiva, compreendendo as dores e oportunidades dos clientes para propor soluções completas de valor agregado ao negócio. Gerir todo o funil de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento e onboarding do cliente sendo usuário modelo dos sistemas da companhia. Sustentar relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes e parceiros de negócio e monitorar tendências de mercado, comportamento da concorrência e oportunidades de crescimento para a sua região de atuação. Trabalhar em sinergia com equipes de produtos e operações para garantir a melhor entrega ao cliente. Ser consultivo para atuar no detalhe durante as negociações sobre os serviços financeiros do Mercado Pago, Meios de Pagamento e Software de Gestão.Requisitos:Possuir graduação completa. Ter experiência na prospecção de clientes para grandes contas no sesgmento de meios de pagamento. Contar com experiência sólida em vendas consultivas B2B nos segmentos de serviços financeiros, adquirência ou meios de pagamento. Possuir vivência comercial em cenários de metas. Possuir disponibilidade para trabalho presencial. Possuir carro próprio.Nós lhe propomos: Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo. Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores. Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas. Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Senior Full-Stack Mobile Engineer (React Native)

title: Ux & Data-Driven Usability Designer

Conduct funnel analysis to identify friction points and conversion drop-offs throughout the purchase process. Partner with product and analytics teams to analyze quantitative data such as conversion rates, abandonment points, and user behavior patterns. Map end-to-end customer journeys to identify quick wins and usability improvements that can drive immediate conversion gains. Design and prototype improvements to transactional flows, focusing on reducing friction and simplifying the purchasing experience. Present insights and design recommendations to stakeholders, clearly tying usability improvements to measurable business impact. If you enjoy solving complex usability challenges and turning data into impactful design decisions, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world's top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized byInc.As aBest Workplacefor three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.What It's Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn't a place for coasting—it's a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you'll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You'll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose:We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intentionIf your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you've been waiting for.About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role isapplying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have... 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgmentand comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness packageCandidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Freight Desk Manager
description: Position Scope TheFreight Desk Manageris a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on theLATAM region. This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets. Responsibilities and Accountabilities Regional Strategy & Expansion:Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding. Global Freight Desk Leadership:Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers. Rate Card Governance:Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cardsacross a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency. Strategic Sourcing:Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiativesfor logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards. Governance & Audit Architecture:Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments. Control Tower Oversight:Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes. Automation & Process Engineering:Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency. Stakeholder Management:Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs. Mandatory Requirements Experience:Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments. Regional Expertise:Deep knowledge of theLATAM logistics landscape, including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks. Procurement Mastery:Proven track record inleading RFQsand managing complexlogistics supplier onboardingprocesses. Network Management:Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and "Control Tower" operational models. Technical Proficiency:Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments. Leadership:Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR). Education:Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field. Languages:Fluency inEnglishis essential for regional and global coordination. Desirable Requirements Advanced Education:MBA or Master's degree. Process Excellence:Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience. Digital Transformation:Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools. Rapid Growth Background:Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.G., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti's cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLE The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers. In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti's broader mission.WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.
- Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.
- Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.
- Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.
- Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.
- Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.
- Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team's scope.
- Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.WHAT IT TAKES
- Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.
- Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.G., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS).
- Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.
- Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.Be fully aligned to our core values:
- Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have.
- Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
- Take Action - Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
- Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.WHAT WE OFFER
- Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
- Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
- Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone.
- Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
- Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
- An open organisation. Titles don't define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone's work is seen and valued.Our Commitment to Inclusion At Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

title: Técnico De Manutenção Preventiva - Inspeção De Elevadores
description:
Nós Elevamos... Qualidade de vida urbanaOs nossos elevadores, escadas e esteiras rolantes transportam com segurança mais de dois bilhões de pessoas em edifícios e centros de transporte todos os dias. Disponibilidade para viagens Experiência com manutenção de elevadores, escadas e esteiras.O que você ganha com isso? Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
Previdência Privada e Cooperativa de Crédito;
Vale Refeição (com possibilidade de desmembramento parcial para Vale Alimentação) ou Restaurante no local – de acordo com a localidade de atuação;
Vale Transporte;
Plano de saúde, Assistência Odontológica, Assistência Farmácia Seguro de Vida e de Acidentes Pessoais;
Eleve-se (Atendimento eapoio de profissionais especializados em Psicologia, Jurídico, Assistência Social, Nutrição, Educação Física, Fisioterapia, Educação Financeira, Pedagogia, e Assessoria PET);
Licença maternidade/paternidade estendida;
Cesta de Natal e Brinquedo para filhos de até 11 anos;
Plataforma de aprendizagem online de idiomas gratuita;
Parceria de descontos com universidades e outras instituições de ensino. Wellhub.Nós Elevamos... Sua carreiraFaça parte da nossa equipe e nos ajude a melhorar a qualidade de vida e a impulsionar a inovação, elevando o nível de segurança e sustentabilidade. Valorizamos suas diversas habilidades e perspectivas, pois juntos moldamos as cidades sustentáveis de hoje e de amanhã.Você está pronto para embarcar em uma nova jornada? Junte-se ao #TeamSchindler! Descubra mais em nossosite de carreiras.No Grupo Schindler, valorizamos a inclusão e a diversidade, e praticamos a equidade para criar oportunidades iguais para todos. Esforçamo-nos para que todos os candidatos qualificados recebam consideração para emprego independentemente de idade, raça, origem étnica, cor, filiação religiosa, filiação sindical, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, estado civil, origem nacional, nacionalidade, genética e saúde ou deficiência.Serão aceitas apenas candidaturas feitas pelo(a) proprio(a) candidato(a). Candidaturas realizadas por teceiros, agências de recrutamento ou headhunters, não serão aceitas.

description:

title: Pessoa Gerente Financeira
description:
A Knewin é a maior empresa de PR e Marketing Tech da América Latina. Nós transformamos dados em decisões estratégicas. Com o uso de inteligência artificial e monitoramento de mídia de ponta, ajudamos marcas globais a entenderem sua reputação e o mercado em tempo real. Somos movidos por inovação, mas o que realmente nos sustenta são as pessoas. Se você busca um ambiente dinâmico, onde a tecnologia e a estratégia caminham juntas, seu lugar é aqui.Responsabilidades e atribuições: Gestão de Pessoas e Estrutura da Área: Liderar, desenvolver e estruturar o time financeiro, garantindo clareza de papéis, evolução técnica e um ambiente orientado a resultados e eficiência operacional. Faturamento (Billing): Assegurar a acuracidade e escalabilidade do faturamento, garantindo aderência ao modelo de negócio (SaaS/recorrente), com foco em eficiência operacional e mitigação de riscos. Contas a Receber (AR) e Gestão de Inadimplência: Definir estratégias e acompanhar indicadores de recebimento, atuando na redução de inadimplência, melhoria do ciclo de caixa e eficiência na conversão de receita em caixa. Contas a Pagar (AP) e Tesouraria: Gerir o fluxo de caixa de curto, médio e longo prazo, garantindo liquidez, otimização do capital de giro e alocação eficiente dos recursos financeiros. Compras e Gestão de Custos: Gerir processos de compras e contratos, buscando eficiência, redução de custos e melhoria contínua na relação com fornecedores. Controles Internos e Compliance: Estruturar e garantir a aderência a políticas, processos e controles financeiros, assegurando conformidade, governança e mitigação de riscos. Análises Gerenciais e Interface com Diretoria: Consolidar e apresentar análises financeiras (DRE, fluxo de caixa, unit economics, indicadores de performance), apoiando a diretoria na tomada de decisão estratégica. Estruturação de Processos e Eficiência: Identificar oportunidades de melhoria, automação e ganho de escala nos processos financeiros, elevando o nível de maturidade da área.Requisitos e qualificações: Formação superior completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência consolidadaem gestão de áreas financeiras;
Experiência na liderança de equipes e desenvolvimento de pessoas;
Conhecimento sólido em Tesouraria, Contas a Pagar/Receber, Faturamento e Planejamento Financeiro;
Domínio de sistemas ERPe ferramentas de análise (Excel/Google Sheets).Também é legal se você tiver: Pós-graduação ou especialização em Finanças, Controladoria ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência em empresasSaaS ou modelos de receita recorrente;
Vivência em ambientes dinâmicos;
Experiência com estruturação de processos, automações e melhoria contínua;
Conhecimento em indicadores financeiros de SaaS (MRR, churn, LTV, CAC, NRR, etc.);
Experiência em interação com investidores, auditorias ou governança corporativa.

title: Key Account Manager
description: Job Summary We are seeking a Key Account Manager to manage, nurture, and grow existing client relationships with HBX Group. This role is essential in ensuring client satisfaction, driving account performance, and identifying opportunities for incremental growth. You will be responsible for client onboarding, operational optimization, and ongoing engagement, while collaborating cross-functionally to deliver a seamless and impactful customer experience.Key Responsibilities Client Relationship Management Maintain and strengthen relationships with assigned key accounts. Conduct regular client meetings, monthly performance reviews, and reporting. Serve as the main point of contact, ensuring timely resolution of issues and alignment with client goals.Account Activation & Optimization Understand client operations across departments (e.G., tech, pricing, mapping). Support onboarding of new products and services using Salesforce and Salesloft. Monitor account performance and implement optimization strategies for distribution and pricing.Growth & Retention Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities based on client needs and market trends. Build rapport across various levels of the client's organization. Collaborate with internal teams to ensure delivery of client-specific solutions and improvements.Required Skills Strong relationship-building and account management capabilities. Commercial acumen and consultative selling approach. Excellent communication, negotiation, and influencing skills. Ability to manage multiple projects and adapt to changing priorities. Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and drive decisions. Proactive, customer-focused, and results-oriented.Required Tech Skills Proficiency in Salesforce, Salesloft, and BI tools (e.G., Tableau). Strong command of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. Basic understanding of API functionality and travel tech platforms.Qualifications & Experience 5+ years in account management, sales, or client services. Fluent in English and source market language (essential). Willingness to travel up to 30% for client visits and meetings. Experience in matrixed organizations and tech-enabled environments. Background in travel, financial services, or related industries is a plus.At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference.

title: Senior Content Manager
description: As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media's growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.This role contributes directly to the CORE department's objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.To be more specific, you will:Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.The ideal profileWe're looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.You are someone who:Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must) Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus) Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing itYou bring strong CM fundamentals:High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills Ownership mindset over site and content performance Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals Experience working with CMS platformsYou work well with others and think ahead:Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potentialFeeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.Next steps in the process 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role's requirements 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!What's in it for youA full time remote work environment. A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results, not hours. Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path. Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun. We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!MoveUp MediaWe're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of iGaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords.With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!Our approachWe focus on people. We put end users' experience as a priority on all strategies and processes. Thus, we aim to make complex topics easy to understand and provide exactly what our audience is seeking. We achieve this by carefully analyzing data and reflecting upon it, writing the content with care, and ensuring a smooth user experience.Here at MoveUp Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce leads to greater teamwork and success. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future! Note: If you have any more questions or need further assistance for specific arrangements linked to your recruitment process, feel free to contact
